description: This file defines the LoanProductMinMaxConstraints class, which encapsulates the minimum and maximum constraints for a loan product, including principal amounts, interest rates, and repayment counts. It provides methods to update these constraints based on JsonCommand input and handles details related to interest rate formatting and constraints adjustments.

classes.name: LoanProductMinMaxConstraints
classes.description: Represents the minimum and maximum constraints for loan product parameters such as principal amounts, interest rates, and repayment counts. Provides functionalities to update constraints based on commands and handle interest rate formatting.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates the min/max constraints based on the provided JsonCommand, tracking changes and updating relevant fields.

methods.name: getMinNominalInterestRatePerPeriod
methods.description: Retrieves the minimum nominal interest rate per period as a BigDecimal, handling null values and formatting.

methods.name: getMaxNominalInterestRatePerPeriod
methods.description: Retrieves the maximum nominal interest rate per period as a BigDecimal, handling null values and formatting.

methods.name: updateForFloatingInterestRates
methods.description: Sets the interest rate constraints to null, indicating floating interest rates.
